idea-plugin.name: clj-kondo-fix
idea-plugin.description:
Fixes Clojure code with clj-kondo-fix, which runs the clj-kondo linter and automatically corrects the findings it knows how to fix, such as unused requires, redundant forms, and unsorted namespaces.

Code | Fix with clj-kondo-fix, also in the editor's context menu, fixes the current .clj, .cljs, or .cljc file, including unsaved changes, as one undoable edit. The project's .clj-kondo configuration applies.

The plugin includes the clj-kondo-fix binary for macOS and Linux. A different executable can be set under Settings | Tools | clj-kondo-fix.

action.description: Apply clj-kondo-fix auto-fixes to the current file
